# FG-DEPLOY-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`deploy`](../../ops/runbooks/deploy.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_target_resolving_to_loopback_is_refused_at_connect` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: デプロイ先のアドレスが許可されていないため、接続しませんでした。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The deployment target address is not allowed, so forge did not connect. Give the request ID to the administrator.
- id: Alamat tujuan deployment tidak diizinkan, sehingga forge tidak terhubung. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 review: when the worker connected, the target host resolved to an address forge never connects to (loopback, unspecified, link-local including 169.254.169.254, multicast), outside `deploy.allowed_networks` when set, or the port is one forge itself listens on. Checked at registration for a literal address and again at every connect after name resolution (ssh then connects to the checked address, the pinned key matched by name through HostKeyAlias). Nothing ran on the target.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.target_failed` (error) with `error_code`, `deployment_id`, `target`, `host`, `port` and `reason` (`denied_address` / `outside_allowed_networks` / `forge_port` / `unresolved`); the resolved address is in the log, not in the API.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook deploy (Target not allowed): fix the DNS record or the target (an administrator, PUT …/targets/{name}), or add the network to `deploy.allowed_networks` and restart forge worker.
